source.paper: Wdowik, Varade, Vejpravova, Legut 2025, Magneto-Raman effect in van der Waals layered two-dimensional CrSBr antiferromagnet, arXiv:2503.15298 (preprint v1; journal version not verified)
source.figure: Fig. 3 (2L trace, peaks labelled A_g^1, A_g^2, A_g^3); Table A3 'Present exp.' column gives only ML and bulk positions; layer count from AFM (Fig. A1, 1L about 0.8 nm)

notes: 2L flake, room temperature, WITec, 532 nm, backscattering; linear polarization of Fig. 3 not stated. The paper labels the three Ag peaks in every Fig. 3 trace but states positions only for ML and bulk (Table A3), and states that Ag1 and Ag2 blueshift with increasing layer number while Ag3 barely moves. Truth positions are therefore the midpoints of the ML and bulk values with tolerances spanning both (curator bracket, not author-stated per-layer numbers). Unassigned features (e.g. near 302 cm-1 in thin flakes) are not in the answer key. Substrate not stated. Temperature stated only as room temperature (300 K used).
